messages:
incident-bot: Pager: continuous-batching perf cliff detected in us-west-2 (cont-batch-scheduler). High latency and error rate on service 'redwood-infer-runtime'. Triggers: p95 token latency > 2.5s, 502 spikes. Escalation to oncall.

sara_oncall: Acked. seeing big queue depth on cb-queues-3, microbatch size jumps to ~256 under stress, KV cache miss rate skyrocketing ~87%.

mike_sre: Copy. attaching quick metrics snapshot: p50=60ms p95=2.9s p99=6.1s, errors=4.2% (baseline ~0.1%).

eva_eng: This looks like the scheduler overshoots batching window at high concurrency. microbatch target should clamp at 64 but controller isn't enforcing. KV cache thrashing - evictions per sec up 12x.

sara_oncall: Customers reporting timeouts. Kevin, any CS alerts?

kevin_support: Carla flagged 3 paying customers (enterprise) experiencing >10% request error rates and some 5xx in their logs. They're on dedicated capacity in us-west-2.

carla_prod: We're prepping customer comms if mitigation takes >30m. Need ETA on rollback/hotfix.

mike_sre: Live mitigation plan: 1) reduce max_concurrency for cont-batch workers in us-west-2 to 60% 2) patch scheduler to cap microbatch at 64 3) enable KV-cache-guard mode to avoid aggressive prefetch. Start with step 1 and monitor.

sara_oncall: Doing step 1 now: `kubectl patch deploy cont-batch-controller -n prod -p '{"spec":{"replicas":4}}'` (reducing worker parallelism) and applying temporary rate-limit policy via router.

deploy-bot: Rollout initiated: cont-batch-controller replicas scaled to 4. Gradual router rate limit applied to shard us-west-2 (20% reduction).

mike_sre: Seeing queue depth drop ~30% after scale-down, p95 down to ~1.8s. Errors not gone yet. Proceeding to hotfix for scheduler.

eva_eng: Pushing hotfix to clamp microbatch and smooth jitter: patch diff includes `max_microbatch=64`, `batch_jitter_ms=8` and extra guard `if(kv_eviction_rate>0.2) disable_prefetch=true`.

sara_oncall: Apply canary on 2 nodes first. deploy-bot, start canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started on cb-worker-7, cb-worker-9. Hash: sha256:aa12ef.

carla_prod: Noting customer impact: reduced throughput may cause some queued requests but better than 5xx. CS standing by to route priority customers.

mike_sre: Canary metrics look good for 5m: p95 down to 1.2s, kv_miss_rate down to 32%. No increase in tail errors. Rolling out to remaining workers.

eva_eng: Rolling patch to remaining cont-batch workers in us-west-2. Also enabling KV cache per-shard memory cap to avoid blowups. Command: `systemctl restart cont-batch-worker --patch` (automation will handle sequencing).

sara_oncall: Full rollout complete. p50=55ms p95=980ms p99=2.3s, errors down to 0.25%. Beginning post-mit checks for 15m.

carla_prod: Sending interim customer note: "We've mitigated the issue and are monitoring — you may see reduced throughput briefly; no data loss."

kevin_support: Customers acknowledged, appreciate speed. Two asked for timeline for root cause.

mike_sre: Short RCA: under sustained high concurrency the continuous-batching scheduler's estimation algorithm over-aggregated tokens, pushing microbatch sizes very large. That triggered aggressive prefetch behavior in KV cache, causing eviction storms and increased latency due to cache churn. Also jitter smoothing disabled in last release (v2.14.0) exposed us to sync bursts.

eva_eng: Follow-ups (assigned): 1) revert risky scheduler heuristic and add unit tests (eva_eng) 2) add canary threshold alerting for microbatch > 128 (mike_sre) 3) update runbook with forced concurrency cap steps and customer comms template (sara_oncall + carla_prod) 4) long-term: adaptive batching algorithm that respects KV pressure metrics (research).

sara_oncall: Handing off to second shift: @mike_sre you'll take next 8h watch, escalate if errors >0.5% or p95 >1.5s.

mike_sre: Taking it. Will also correlate with storage eviction logs and open infra ticket for KV sizing review.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: cont-batch perf cliff mitigated, severity reduced to P2, postmortem requested.

carla_prod: Thanks team. I'll draft customer note summarizing impact and mitigation.

eva_eng: I'll open PR for the hotfix commits and link postmortem. Also adding e2e tests for jitter config.

sara_oncall: Closing thread but keep monitoring. If anyone sees regression ping here. :thumbsup:
